question: A charged particle enters a uniform magnetic field with velocity $\vec{v}$ making an angle $\theta$ with the magnetic field $\vec{B}$. Obtain the expression for the magnitude of magnetic force on it. How will the force change if the angle becomes $90^\circ$? Justify your answer.

options.B: $\vec F=q(\vec v\times\vec B)$, so $F=qvB\sin\theta$. At $\theta=90^\circ$, $F_{\max}=qvB$ because the complete velocity is perpendicular to $\vec B$.
options.C: $F=qvB$ for every angle, so changing the angle to $90^\circ$ does not affect the force.
